component.name: Deezer Downloader
component.summary: Search and download music from Deezer

description.p: A native GTK4 / libadwaita desktop frontend for deezer-downloader. Search Deezer for tracks, albums and artists, drill down into an artist's top tracks or full album list, paste a public playlist URL or download your loved tracks, then start a queue of downloads and watch them complete track by track.

ul.li: Search Deezer for tracks, albums and artists
Drill down into an artist's top tracks or albums
Download public Deezer playlists by URL or ID
Queue with per-track progress, cancel and retry
Live preferences for ARL cookie, quality, download folder and proxy

description.p: Requires a valid Deezer ARL cookie. A free Deezer account is enough for 128 kbit/s MP3 downloads; FLAC and 320 kbit/s require a premium subscription.
